description.description: What it is for, in plain text.

sql.description: One SELECT. A table is named by its path, in double quotes when it has a `/` or a `-`. A parameter is written $1, $2 and so on, in the order of `parameters`.

parameters.description: What the query is given each time it is run: `$1` is the first.

name.description: What the parameter is called by whoever runs the query.

type.description: What the parameter holds. A value that does not fit is refused.

label.description: What the parameter is called where a person is asked for it.

default.description: Used when the query is run without this parameter.

required.description: Whether the query cannot be run without it.
